brief_summary: To examine the lung when people with diabetes take an inhaled form of insulin, compared to subcutaneous insulin.
brief_title: To Examine the Lung When People With Diabetes Take an Inhaled Form of Insulin, Compared to Subcutaneous Insulin.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
* Normal lung function

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smokers

official_title: A Phase 2, Exploratory Study to Examine the Effects of Inhaled Insulin, Compared With Subcutaneously Administered Insulin, on Airway Lining Fluid Composition in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.

primary_outcomes.measure: To assess in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus the effects, if any, on lung lining fluid cell count and differential within subjects after 12 weeks of inhaled insulin therapy compared to 12 weeks of subcutaneous short-acting therapy.
